foundation.q2.title: No uuta reepu rogaa nuugono uusa? Bii?
foundation.q2.subtitle: Kaa i uutoo. No uuru gaabii rogaa uuto.
foundation.q2.opt1: Togaa — titi kuuto uudi, uusa taga
foundation.q2.opt3: Fiertsu — tapas nahi ditut, erretzea nahi dut
foundation.q2.opt4: Monastiko — egunaren gehiengoa honen barruan nahi dut
foundation.q3.title: Zure onena amesten duzunean, zer dira...
foundation.q3.opt2: Na love — dissolved into something larger
foundation.q4.title: O le matapula e sili ona latalata ia te oe i le taimi nei?
foundation.q4.opt6: Galuega malosi — anava, tekinolosi i totonu, ola
foundation.q5.title: O le ā le mea e te i ai e toe mafaufau?
foundation.q5.opt1: Se talitonuga ua ou taofia talu mai le uluai taimi
foundation.q5.opt2: E howa au i aku hoa
foundation.q5.opt3: Taku whanaungatanga ki te mahi me te kaha
foundation.q5.opt4: E pēhea taku tiaki i tēnei tinana
foundation.q5.opt5: Te mea e tuku ana au kia rongo
foundation.q5.opt6: Ko wai au e whakaaro nei ko au
foundation.q5.opt7: Te mea e hanga ana au ki reira
foundation.q6.title: Ko tēhea te mea tino pono?
foundation.q6.opt1: Ka tupu te ao ki a au
foundation.q6.opt2: He kōwhiringa ētahi kei ahau mō taku urupare
foundation.q6.opt3: Ko te māramatanga te hanga i taku mea pono
foundation.q6.opt4: E ola tasi to'atasi te matamata
foundation.q7.title: A iai se mea faigata e tupu, o fea e te muamua alu i ai?
foundation.q7.subtitle: Fa'ailoga le gaioiga muamua lava.
foundation.q7.opt1: I lo'u ulu — su'esu'e, fuafua, toe fai
foundation.q7.opt2: I lo'u loto — lagonaina, aapa atu i se tasi
foundation.q7.opt3: I le gaioiga — gaoioi, fa'asa'o, fai se mea
foundation.q8.title: O le ā le masani o lau matamata i ou lava manatu?
foundation.q8.opt2: Na ou taumafai, i lea taimi ma lea taimi
foundation.q8.opt3: Ou te faataitaia e le aunoa
foundation.q8.opt4: O se vaega tumau lea o lo'u olaga
foundation.analysis.eyebrow: O le mea lenei ou te vaaia
foundation.analysis.subtitle: O le a suia lenei mea a o e faataitaia. E leai se mea e tumau — o le uiga lena o le mea lea.
foundation.analysis.bandNote: O le a tatou toe faitauina lenei mea i nai aso uma. E feosofi vaega. O le uiga lena o le mea lea.
foundation.brain.head.label: Ta'ita'iina e le ulu
foundation.brain.heart.label: Ta'ita'iina e le loto
foundation.brain.gut.line: Muus siir. Wi slo yu jis inaagi fe hiir wats onida.
foundation.paths.observationDesc: Kapinge yini eyenzekayo, ngaphandle kokubamba noma ukucindezela. Yonke indlela esihamba ngayo ndawonye iqala kulesi sihlalo.
foundation.paths.startingPoint: Ky është pika jote e nisjes — jo një kafaz. Rruga jote do të zhvillohet bashkë me ty.
foundation.archetype.creator: Le Fa'avae
